At lumeero, we understand that receiving your order safely and on time is an important part of your shopping experience.

We aim to provide customers with a convenient, transparent, and reliable delivery experience. This Shipping & Delivery Policy explains our shipping coverage, order processing procedures, estimated delivery timelines, shipping charges, tracking information, and how to request assistance with delivery concerns.
This policy applies to eligible purchases made through https://lumeero.us, operated by Stone Canyon Leathers.
1. Business Information
Store Name: lumeero
Legal Business Name: Stone Canyon Leathers
Website: https://lumeero.us
Business Address: 6715 4th St NW, Los Ranchos De Albuquerque, NM 87107, United States
Customer Support Email: info@lumeero.site
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Our business contact address is provided for correspondence and should not be assumed to be a warehouse, fulfillment center, retail pickup location, or authorized return address.
2. Shipping Coverage
United States Shipping
lumeero currently offers shipping to eligible addresses within the United States.
Delivery availability may depend on the product, destination, carrier service, and applicable shipping restrictions.
Some destinations, including Alaska, Hawaii, US territories, PO boxes, APO/FPO addresses, and remote locations, may have additional limitations or different delivery requirements.
Available shipping options will be presented during checkout.
International Shipping
We do not currently offer international shipping as a standard service.
Orders must be placed using an eligible US delivery address.
3. Shipping Charges
Standard Shipping
Standard Shipping Fee: FREE
We offer free standard shipping on eligible orders delivered within the contiguous United States.
No minimum purchase amount is required for eligible standard shipping orders.
Customers can review their shipping options and any applicable charges before completing checkout.
Additional charges may apply only where a special delivery service, restricted destination, oversized product, or other exception is clearly disclosed before the order is submitted.
If an order is not eligible for free standard shipping, the applicable shipping cost will be displayed at checkout.
4. Order Processing Time
Processing Time: 1–2 Business Days
Orders are generally processed within 1–2 business days after successful payment confirmation and order acceptance.
Order processing may include:
* Payment confirmation
* Order information verification
* Inventory availability checks
* Product preparation
* Packaging
* Shipping label generation
* Carrier handoff arrangements
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding recognized holidays.
Orders placed on weekends or holidays generally begin processing on the next business day.
Certain orders may require additional review or processing time.
5. Daily Order Cut-Off Time
Order Cut-Off: 4:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)
Orders successfully placed and accepted before 4:00 PM MT on a business day may begin processing that day.
Orders placed after the cut-off time generally begin processing on the following business day.
The cut-off time determines when processing may begin; it does not guarantee same-day dispatch.
Orders requiring additional verification or affected by inventory availability may take longer.
6. Estimated Shipping & Delivery Times
We aim to provide reasonable delivery estimates based on our standard shipping process.
Shipping Stage
Estimated Time
Order Processing
1–2 business days
Standard Shipping Transit
3–7 business days
Total Estimated Delivery
4–9 business days
Understanding the Delivery Timeline
Order Processing: The time required to verify, prepare, and arrange shipment of your order.
Shipping Transit: The time the carrier generally requires to transport the package after accepting it.
Total Estimated Delivery: The combined estimated processing and transit time.
Delivery estimates are calculated in business days and exclude weekends and applicable holidays.
These timelines are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.
Actual delivery may vary depending on the product, destination, carrier availability, weather, operational disruptions, or other circumstances.
If a specific delivery deadline is important, please contact customer support before placing your order.
7. Shipping Carriers
Depending on the product, destination, and shipping requirements, orders may be shipped using established delivery providers such as:
* UPS
* FedEx
* USPS
* DHL or other eligible logistics providers
The carrier used for an order depends on available shipping arrangements.
Customers generally cannot select a specific carrier unless that option is offered during checkout.
Some products may be shipped using specialized delivery services where necessary.
8. Order Confirmation
After successfully placing an order, customers should receive an order confirmation through the email address provided during checkout.
The confirmation may include:
* Order number
* Purchased products
* Order total
* Billing and shipping information
* Selected payment method
* Relevant order details
An order confirmation acknowledges that the order has been submitted. It does not necessarily mean the order has already shipped.
If you do not receive an order confirmation, please check your spam or junk folder.
If you still cannot locate it, contact us at info@lumeero.site.
9. Shipping Confirmation & Tracking
Track Your Delivery
Once your order has been shipped and tracking information is available, we aim to provide the relevant shipment details.
Tracking information may include:
* Shipping carrier
* Tracking number
* Shipment status
* Estimated delivery information, where provided by the carrier
Tracking updates may take 24–48 hours after carrier acceptance to appear in the tracking system.
A shipping label being created does not necessarily mean the carrier has physically received the package.
Customers can check tracking information through the carrier's website or contact our support team for assistance.
Track Your Order: https://lumeero.us/track-your-order/
10. Multiple Items & Split Shipments
If an order contains multiple products, items may occasionally be shipped separately.
This can happen because of:
* Different product handling requirements
* Inventory location
* Packaging needs
* Carrier restrictions
* Product availability
When an order is shipped in multiple packages, customers may receive separate tracking information for each shipment.
Split shipments do not necessarily mean that an item is missing from the order.
If you have concerns about a partially delivered order, contact our support team with your order number.
11. Shipping Address Accuracy
Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete delivery information during checkout.
Please verify:
* Recipient's full name
* Street address
* Apartment, suite, or unit number, where applicable
* City
* State
* ZIP code
* Contact phone number
* Email address
Incorrect or incomplete shipping information can result in delays, unsuccessful delivery attempts, or packages being returned.
Need to Correct Your Address?
Contact us immediately at info@lumeero.site or through live chat.
If the order has not yet shipped, we will review whether the address can be updated.
Once the shipment has been transferred to the carrier, address changes may be restricted or unavailable.
Additional shipping charges caused by customer-provided address errors may apply where permitted by law and disclosed before collection.
12. Delivery Delays
While we aim to meet published delivery estimates, delays may occur.
Potential causes include:
* Severe weather conditions
* Carrier disruptions
* High shipping volumes
* Public holidays
* Transportation interruptions
* Incorrect delivery information
* Inventory discrepancies
* Payment or order verification
* Remote delivery locations
* Events beyond reasonable operational control
If your order is delayed, contact our support team for assistance.
We will review available shipment information and explain the next steps.
Any applicable legal rights concerning delayed or undelivered goods remain unaffected by this policy.
13. Lost or Missing Packages
What if My Order Hasn't Arrived?
If your package has not arrived within the expected delivery window, please contact our support team.
Include:
* Order number
* Name associated with the order
* Email address used at checkout
* Tracking number, if available
* Brief description of the concern
Our team can review the available shipping records and, where appropriate, coordinate with the carrier.
If a shipment is confirmed lost or cannot be delivered, the available resolution will depend on the circumstances and applicable consumer protection laws.
Customers are not required to resolve a merchant's delivery obligations solely through the carrier.
14. Package Marked Delivered but Not Received
If the tracking information shows that your package was delivered but you cannot locate it, we recommend:
1. Confirming the shipping address on your order.
2. Checking the front entrance, porch, mailbox, and other usual delivery locations.
3. Checking any carrier delivery photograph or delivery notes.
4. Asking household members or building reception whether they accepted the package.
5. Contacting lumeero customer support if the package remains missing.
We may review carrier records and available delivery evidence to investigate the concern.
A delivered tracking status alone does not automatically determine the outcome of a missing-package claim.
15. Damaged Packages or Products
We want customers to receive their purchases in the condition described.
If your order arrives visibly damaged or the product appears damaged after opening, please contact us promptly.
How to Report Damage
Email info@lumeero.site with:
* Your order number
* A description of the damage
* Photographs of the product
* Photographs of the outer packaging, if available
* Photographs of the shipping label, where relevant
We recommend reporting visible shipping damage within 48 hours of delivery, where reasonably possible, to assist with carrier documentation.
This recommendation does not eliminate applicable return rights, warranty protections, or statutory remedies.
Our team will review the information and explain the available resolution options.
Returns & Refunds: https://lumeero.us/return-and-refund-policy/
16. Incorrect Items or Missing Products
If you receive an item different from the product ordered, or an item appears to be missing from your shipment, contact our customer support team.
Please provide:
* Order number
* Description of the issue
* Photographs of the received item, where relevant
* Packaging details, if available
We will review your order and available fulfillment information.
If a merchant error is confirmed, we will explain the appropriate corrective action, which may include fulfillment of the correct item or a refund where applicable.
17. Failed Delivery Attempts
Some shipments may require:
* A recipient signature
* Delivery confirmation
* Additional carrier verification
* Access to a secure delivery location
If a carrier cannot complete delivery, it may attempt redelivery, provide pickup instructions, or return the shipment.
Customers should follow the carrier's instructions and contact our support team if assistance is required.
Any additional delivery charges will be handled according to the circumstances, applicable disclosures, and law.
18. Returned-to-Sender Packages
A shipment may be returned to the sender because of:
* An incorrect address
* An incomplete address
* Repeated unsuccessful delivery attempts
* An unclaimed package
* Carrier delivery restrictions
* Other delivery complications
If a package is returned to the sender, contact customer support.
We will review the reason for the return and explain available options, which may include reshipment or refund as appropriate.
Any additional reshipping costs will depend on the cause of the return and applicable law.
19. Oversized or Special-Handling Products
Some electronics and related products may require additional handling because of their size, weight, fragility, or shipping restrictions.
For eligible products, special handling may involve:
* Additional protective packaging
* Specialized carriers
* Different transit estimates
* Delivery appointment coordination
* Signature requirements
Any material shipping restrictions or additional charges should be disclosed before checkout.
Customers should review the individual product listing for any special delivery information.
20. Order Changes & Cancellations
If you need to change or cancel an order, please contact us as soon as possible.
We will review the request based on the order's current fulfillment status.
Once an order has shipped, cancellation may no longer be possible through the standard process.
Customers may still have return rights under our published policies and applicable law.
Order Cancellation Policy: https://lumeero.us/cancellation-policy/
21. Returns After Delivery
If you receive an order and wish to request a return, please review our Return and Refund Policy.
Return eligibility may depend on:
* The reason for the return
* Product condition
* The applicable return window
* Product category
* Packaging and included accessories
* Applicable legal requirements
Do not send products to our published business address without authorization.
Return and Refund Policy: https://lumeero.us/return-and-refund-policy/
22. Customer Responsibilities
To help support a smooth delivery experience, customers should:
* Provide accurate shipping information.
* Review the order details before submitting payment.
* Monitor available shipment communications.
* Follow reasonable carrier delivery instructions.
* Contact support promptly about delivery problems.
* Provide relevant information when requesting assistance.
These responsibilities do not limit any non-waivable consumer rights or excuse the merchant from its legal obligations.
23. Our Shipping Commitment
At lumeero, our goal is to provide customers with a clear and convenient delivery experience.
We aim to:
* Explain shipping eligibility and charges before checkout.
* Provide realistic processing and delivery estimates.
* Share tracking information when available.
* Communicate relevant order updates.
* Assist with shipping-related questions.
* Review reports of missing, damaged, or incorrect deliveries.
* Handle customer concerns in accordance with our policies and applicable law.
We recognize that timely delivery and clear communication are important parts of a positive shopping experience.
24. Contact Us for Shipping Assistance
If you have questions about shipping, tracking, delivery delays, or an existing order, please contact our customer support team.
Store Name: lumeero
Legal Business Name: Stone Canyon Leathers
Website: https://lumeero.us
Email: info@lumeero.site
Business Address: 6715 4th St NW, Los Ranchos De Albuquerque, NM 87107, United States
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Contact Us: https://lumeero.us/contact-us/
Order Help Center: https://lumeero.us/order-help-center/
25. Policy Updates
We may update this Shipping & Delivery Policy to reflect changes in our shipping operations, carrier arrangements, delivery coverage, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on this page with its updated date.
Changes will not retroactively eliminate rights applicable to orders already placed.

lines: Returns & Refunds Policy
Effective Date: November 7, 2026
Last Updated: November 7, 2026

At lumeero, customer satisfaction is an important part of our shopping experience. We understand that sometimes a product may not meet your expectations, arrive damaged, or need to be returned for another reason.
Our goal is to provide a fair, transparent, and straightforward return and refund process.

This Returns & Refunds Policy explains return eligibility, the return request process, product condition requirements, return shipping responsibilities, refund processing, and how we handle damaged, defective, or incorrect products.
This policy applies to eligible purchases made through https://lumeero.us, operated by Stone Canyon Leathers.
1. Business Information
Store Name: lumeero
Legal Business Name: Stone Canyon Leathers
Website: https://lumeero.us
Business Address: 6715 4th St NW, Los Ranchos De Albuquerque, NM 87107, United States
Customer Support Email: info@lumeero.site
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Our published business address is for business correspondence and is not an authorized return shipping destination unless specifically confirmed by our support team.
2. Our 30-Day Return Policy
We offer a 30-calendar-day return window for eligible products purchased through our website.
The return period begins on the date the order is delivered to the customer.
To request a return, customers must contact us within 30 calendar days of delivery.
Returns are subject to the eligibility requirements described in this policy.
Return Policy Overview
Policy Detail
Terms
Return Window
30 calendar days after delivery
Return Request
Contact customer support
Change-of-Mind Returns
Accepted for eligible products
Product Condition
Unused, uninstalled, and in original condition
Original Packaging
Required for change-of-mind returns where reasonably applicable
Restocking Fee
Change-of-Mind Return Shipping
Customer responsibility
Verified Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items
Seller-paid return shipping where required
Refund Processing
Generally within 10 business days after receipt, inspection, and approval
Refund Method
Original payment method where supported
Direct Exchanges
Subject to availability and support approval
This policy does not restrict any non-waivable rights available under applicable consumer protection laws.
3. Return Eligibility Requirements
To qualify for a standard change-of-mind return, the product must generally meet the following requirements:
* The return request is submitted within 30 calendar days of delivery.
* The product has not been used or installed.
* The product is in its original condition.
* All included accessories, cables, manuals, and components are returned.
* Original product packaging is included where reasonably applicable.
* The product has not been damaged through misuse, improper handling, or unauthorized modification.
* Proof of purchase or an order number is provided.
* The return is authorized through our customer support process.
Products that do not meet these conditions may not qualify for a standard change-of-mind return.
Different requirements may apply to products that are damaged, defective, incorrectly supplied, or otherwise covered by applicable consumer rights.
4. How to Request a Return
We aim to make the return process easy to understand.
Step 1 - Contact Customer Support
Email info@lumeero.site or contact us through our 24/7 live chat.
Please provide:
* Your order number
* Full name
* Email address used during checkout
* Product name
* Reason for the return
* Photographs, if relevant
Step 2 - Return Eligibility Review
Our support team will review the request according to the product details, purchase date, reason for return, and applicable policy.
We may request additional information where reasonably necessary.
Step 3 - Receive Return Instructions
If the return is approved, we will provide the applicable return instructions.
These may include:
* Return authorization details
* Designated return shipping address
* Packaging instructions
* Shipping label information, where applicable
* Any relevant handling requirements
Important: Do not send products to our published business address without receiving authorization and the correct return destination.
Step 4 - Prepare Your Return
Package the product securely to help prevent damage during return transportation.
Include the product and all required accessories, documentation, and components.
For eligible change-of-mind returns, the item should remain in its original condition.
Step 5 - Ship the Product
Send the product using the approved return procedure.
Where the customer is responsible for return shipping, we recommend using a trackable shipping service.
Retain the shipping receipt and tracking information until the return has been resolved.
Step 6 - Return Inspection
Once the returned item is received, we will inspect it to verify its condition and eligibility.
We may contact you if additional information is needed.
Step 7 - Refund Processing
If the return is approved following inspection, we will initiate the applicable refund.
Refund processing timelines are explained below.
5. Change-of-Mind Returns
We understand that customers may occasionally reconsider a purchase.
Eligible products may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery, provided they meet our standard return requirements.
For a change-of-mind return:
* The item must generally be unused and uninstalled.
* The item must be returned in its original condition.
* Included accessories and components must be returned.
* The customer is responsible for return shipping costs.
* No restocking fee is charged.
* The return must be authorized before shipment.
Original outbound shipping charges, if any, may be nonrefundable where permitted by law and clearly disclosed at purchase.
Products showing signs of use, installation, damage, or missing components may not qualify for a standard change-of-mind refund.
6. Damaged Products
What if My Order Arrives Damaged?
If a product arrives damaged, please contact us promptly.
We recommend reporting visible shipping damage within 48 hours of delivery, where reasonably possible, to help us document the issue and coordinate with the shipping carrier.
This is a recommended reporting period, not an automatic forfeiture of applicable return or legal rights.
Please provide:
* Order number
* Description of the damage
* Photographs of the product
* Photographs of the packaging
* Photographs of the shipping label, if available
Our team will review the report and explain the available options.
Depending on the circumstances, these may include a replacement, refund, or another appropriate remedy.
Where a merchant-responsible return is verified, we will arrange or cover reasonable return shipping as required by the applicable policy and law.
7. Defective Products
If a product appears defective, malfunctioning, or not functioning as described, contact customer support.
Please provide:
* Order number
* Product name and model
* Description of the problem
* Relevant photographs or videos, where helpful
* Troubleshooting steps already attempted, if any
Our team may review the issue to determine whether a return, replacement, manufacturer warranty process, or another remedy applies.
Product warranties vary by manufacturer and product.
Nothing in this policy removes applicable legal rights concerning defective goods.
Warranty & Product Support: https://lumeero.us/warranty/
8. Incorrect Products
If you receive a product that does not match your order, please contact us.
Include your order number and photographs of the received item.
We will review the order and fulfillment information.
If we confirm that an incorrect product was supplied, we will arrange an appropriate resolution, which may include:
* Sending the correct product, subject to availability
* Providing a refund
* Arranging return shipping for the incorrect item, where required
Customers will not be charged a restocking fee for a verified merchant fulfillment error.
9. Missing Items or Accessories
If an item or included accessory appears to be missing from your delivery, please contact us.
Before reporting a missing item, review any shipment notifications to determine whether your order was divided into multiple packages.
If the item is still missing, provide:
* Order number
* Product name
* Description of the missing item
* Photographs of the received contents and packaging, where relevant
Our team will review the available order and shipment records and explain the next steps.
10. Non-Returnable Products and Exceptions
Certain products may be ineligible for standard change-of-mind returns because of their condition, configuration, or other disclosed restrictions.
Examples may include:
* Products damaged through customer misuse
* Products with unauthorized modifications
* Products missing essential components
* Items returned outside the applicable return period
* Certain personalized or custom-configured products, where disclosed
* Digital products or activated software licenses, where legally permitted and clearly disclosed
* Products subject to specific health, safety, or regulatory restrictions
Any product-specific return restriction should be disclosed before purchase.
These exceptions do not override applicable rights for defective, damaged, misdescribed, or incorrectly supplied products.
11. Opened Electronics and Packaging
Electronics may require careful handling during the return process.
For standard change-of-mind returns, products should generally remain unused and in their original condition.
Opening a package does not automatically eliminate legal rights relating to a defective or misdescribed product.
If you are uncertain whether an opened product qualifies for return, contact customer support before shipping it.
12. Return Shipping Costs
Change-of-Mind Returns
Customers are responsible for return shipping costs for approved change-of-mind returns.
The cost depends on the product's size, weight, destination, and selected shipping service.
Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Products

Where a product is verified as damaged upon arrival, defective, or incorrectly supplied, lumeero will cover reasonable return shipping or provide an appropriate return label where required by applicable law and policy.
Unauthorized Returns
Customers should not ship products without receiving return instructions.
We cannot guarantee proper handling of packages sent to an unauthorized address.
13. Restocking Fees
Restocking Fee: $0
We do not charge a standard restocking fee for eligible returns processed under this policy.
Customers may still be responsible for applicable change-of-mind return shipping costs.
14. Return Packaging Requirements
Returned products should be packaged securely.
Where applicable, include:
* Original product
* Original packaging
* Cables and chargers
* Adapters
* Manuals
* Included accessories
* Other components supplied with the product
For change-of-mind returns, missing accessories or damage may affect eligibility.
For defective or damaged goods, we will evaluate the circumstances and applicable consumer rights.
We recommend retaining proof of shipment.
15. Refund Eligibility
Refund eligibility depends on the reason for the return and the applicable policy requirements.
A refund may be approved when:
* An eligible return is received and inspected.
* A qualifying cancellation is accepted.
* A verified merchant fulfillment error requires a refund.
* A product is confirmed lost or undeliverable and a refund is the appropriate remedy.
* A refund is otherwise required by applicable law.
Customers will be informed of the outcome of their return request.
16. Refund Processing Timeline
Standard Refund Processing
For approved returns, we generally aim to initiate refunds within 10 business days after the returned product has been received, inspected, and approved.
The inspection and approval process may require additional time in unusual circumstances.
Once the refund is initiated, the customer's bank or payment provider may require additional processing time before the funds appear.
Business days exclude weekends and applicable holidays.
Where applicable law requires a different or shorter refund deadline, the legal requirement will take precedence.
17. Refund Method
Approved refunds are generally issued to the original payment method used for the purchase, where supported.
Depending on the transaction, this may involve:
* Credit card
* Debit card
* Digital payment provider
* Installment payment provider
Refunds cannot ordinarily be redirected to an unrelated payment account.
If the original payment method is unavailable, contact our support team for guidance on the applicable provider process.
18. Buy Now, Pay Later Refunds
If you paid through an installment or Buy Now, Pay Later service, an approved refund will generally be processed through the relevant payment provider.
The provider may adjust:
* Outstanding installment balances
* Future payment schedules
* Previously collected payments
* Refund amounts
The exact process depends on the provider's terms and the transaction.
Important: Continue following your payment provider's repayment instructions until the provider confirms any adjustment or cancellation of scheduled payments.
For provider-specific questions, contact the relevant payment service directly.
Payment Policy: https://lumeero.us/payment-policy/
19. Partial Refunds
Partial refunds may be considered where appropriate and agreed upon.
Examples may include:
* A customer agrees to retain an item with a documented issue.
* A specific component is missing and an appropriate adjustment is offered.
* A mutually agreed resolution is available instead of returning the entire order.
Partial refunds are not guaranteed and depend on the circumstances.
Customers will be informed of the proposed amount before accepting an optional partial-refund resolution.
20. Exchanges and Replacements
We do not guarantee direct exchanges for standard change-of-mind returns.
If you wish to purchase a different product, the usual process may involve returning the eligible original item and placing a new order.
For verified defective, damaged, or incorrect products, a replacement may be offered where appropriate and available.
Replacement availability depends on inventory and the circumstances of the claim.
21. Order Cancellations and Refunds
If you wish to cancel an order before shipment, contact us as soon as possible.
Cancellation requests are reviewed according to the order's fulfillment status.
If a cancellation is accepted and payment has already been captured, an applicable refund will be initiated.
Once an order has shipped, customers may need to follow the return process after delivery.
Order Cancellation Policy: https://lumeero.us/cancellation-policy/
22. Refused or Undeliverable Shipments
If a package is refused, unclaimed, or returned to the sender, contact customer support.
We will review the circumstances and explain available options.
Any refund or additional shipping charge will depend on the reason for the failed delivery, applicable disclosures, and consumer protection laws.
Customers will not automatically lose their refund rights because a shipment could not be delivered.
23. Lost Packages
If your package does not arrive, contact our support team.
We will review the available tracking and delivery information.
Where an order is confirmed lost or undelivered, we will work toward an appropriate resolution under our shipping obligations and applicable law.
Customers are not required to resolve merchant delivery obligations solely through the shipping carrier.
Shipping & Delivery Policy: https://lumeero.us/shipping-policy/
24. Return Requests Outside the Standard Window
Requests submitted after the standard 30-day return period may not qualify for a change-of-mind return.
However, additional remedies may apply if:
* A product is covered by an applicable manufacturer warranty.
* A defect is subject to legal consumer protections.
* Another statutory or contractual remedy applies.
Contact customer support if you believe your product qualifies for additional assistance.
25. Refund Status Inquiries
If you are waiting for a refund, please check your payment account and any communication from your payment provider.
If the expected processing period has passed, contact us with:
* Order number
* Return authorization details, if available
* Date the return was delivered
* Relevant refund communication
We can review the available refund records and provide information about the transaction status.
26. Payment Disputes and Chargebacks
If you have a concern about an order or refund, we encourage you to contact our customer support team so we can review the issue.
You may also have rights to dispute a transaction through your card issuer, bank, or payment provider.
Nothing in this policy limits your right to initiate a lawful payment dispute or exercise applicable consumer protections.
If a formal payment dispute is opened, the payment provider may manage the transaction according to its dispute procedures.
27. Fair Treatment and Consumer Rights
We aim to apply our return and refund procedures consistently and fairly.
This policy does not exclude, restrict, or waive rights that cannot legally be limited under applicable federal or state consumer protection laws.
Where this policy conflicts with mandatory legal requirements, those requirements will prevail.
28. Our Returns & Refunds Commitment
At lumeero, we aim to make the return process understandable and accessible.
Our commitment includes:
* Clear return eligibility information
* Accessible customer support
* A defined return request procedure
* Transparent return shipping responsibilities
* No standard restocking fee
* Reasonable review of damaged or incorrect item reports
* Clear communication about refund processing
* Respect for applicable consumer rights
We understand that an unexpected issue with an order can be frustrating, and we aim to help customers understand the available resolution options.
29. Contact Us for Return Assistance
For questions about returns, refunds, damaged products, incorrect items, or warranty-related concerns, contact us.
Store Name: lumeero
Legal Business Name: Stone Canyon Leathers
Website: https://lumeero.us
Email: info@lumeero.site
Business Address: 6715 4th St NW, Los Ranchos De Albuquerque, NM 87107, United States
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Contact Us: https://lumeero.us/contact-us/
Order Help Center: https://lumeero.us/order-help-center/
30. Policy Updates
We may update this Returns & Refunds Policy to reflect changes in our operations, product categories, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on this page with the corresponding updated date.
Changes will not retroactively eliminate rights applicable to purchases already made.

This policy applies to purchases made through https://lumeero.us, operated by Stone Canyon Leathers.

We accept cancellation requests for orders that have not yet entered a stage of fulfillment where cancellation is no longer possible.
We recommend contacting our customer support team as soon as possible after placing your order.

3. Cancellation Before Order Processing
Orders that have not yet entered fulfillment are generally eligible for cancellation.
If you contact us shortly after placing your order, we may be able to stop the order before preparation or dispatch begins.
No cancellation fee is charged for approved cancellations.
We recommend contacting us immediately rather than waiting for an order confirmation or shipping notification.

Once an order enters processing, cancellation may become more difficult.
Processing activities can include:
* Payment verification
* Inventory allocation
* Product preparation
* Packaging
* Shipping label creation
* Carrier handoff arrangements
If you request cancellation during this stage, our team will review whether the order can still be stopped.
Cancellation is not guaranteed once fulfillment has begun.
If cancellation is no longer possible, we will explain the available next steps.
5. Cancellation After Shipment
Can I Cancel an Order That Has Already Shipped?
Orders that have already been handed to the shipping carrier generally cannot be canceled through our standard cancellation process.

$0 Cancellation Fee

7. Refunds for Canceled Orders
When a cancellation is approved, we will initiate the applicable refund promptly.
Refunds are generally issued to the original payment method where supported.

* A reversal of a payment authorization
* A cancellation of an unsettled payment
* A refund of a completed payment

If you have not received an expected refund, please contact our support team.
8. Buy Now, Pay Later Cancellations
If your order was paid through a Buy Now, Pay Later or installment payment provider, an approved cancellation will be processed through the relevant provider.
The provider may adjust or cancel scheduled payments according to its terms.
Depending on the transaction, the provider may:
* Cancel an outstanding payment authorization
* Adjust the installment schedule
* Refund previously collected installments
* Update the outstanding balance

9. Changing an Order Instead of Canceling
If you made a mistake while placing your order, cancellation may not always be necessary.
Depending on the fulfillment status, our support team may be able to review requests involving:
* Shipping address corrections
* Contact information updates
* Product quantity changes
* Product variation corrections
* Removal of an item
* Other order adjustments

If you entered an incorrect shipping address, contact us immediately.

* Order number
* Name associated with the order

* Contact information

Shipping & Delivery Policy
11. Duplicate Orders
If you accidentally placed the same order more than once, contact customer support as soon as possible.
Please provide the relevant order numbers and explain which order you wish to cancel.
We will review the status of each order.
If an order is still eligible for cancellation, we can process the approved request without a cancellation fee.
If an order has already shipped, the applicable return process may be required.
12. Accidental Purchases
If you placed an order unintentionally, contact us promptly.
Our support team will review the order status and determine whether cancellation is possible.
We encourage customers to review product details, quantities, shipping information, and payment amounts before completing checkout.
13. Out-of-Stock Products
Although we aim to maintain accurate inventory information, a product may occasionally become unavailable after an order has been placed.
If we cannot fulfill an order because of inventory unavailability, we will contact the customer and explain the available options.
These may include:
* Waiting for replenishment, if offered and agreed upon
* Selecting an alternative product, if available and agreed upon
* Canceling the unavailable item
* Receiving a refund for the unfulfilled item
We will not substitute a materially different product without the customer's agreement.
If we cancel an order because the item cannot be supplied, the customer will receive an appropriate refund.
14. Cancellations Initiated by lumeero
In certain circumstances, lumeero may need to cancel an order.
Possible reasons include:
* Product unavailability
* Incorrect or incomplete order information
* Payment authorization failure
* Suspected fraudulent activity requiring verification
* Shipping restrictions
* An obvious pricing or listing error
* Other circumstances preventing lawful fulfillment
If we cancel an order, we will communicate the outcome and arrange any refund due.
We will not retain payment for goods that we cancel and do not supply.
Any cancellation rights and remedies required by applicable law will take precedence.
15. Payment Verification Issues
Some orders may require additional payment or identity verification.
If an order cannot be verified, fulfillment may be delayed or the order may be canceled where permitted.
We may contact the customer to request appropriate information through secure channels.
For your protection, do not send complete payment card numbers, card security codes, passwords, or other sensitive payment credentials through email or live chat.
16. Partial Order Cancellations
If your order contains multiple products, you may request cancellation of one or more items.
Partial cancellation is subject to the fulfillment status of each item.
If an item can be canceled, an applicable partial refund may be issued.
If the item has already shipped, the return process may apply.
Contact support with your order number and the specific items you wish to cancel.
17. Refusing Delivery
Refusing a shipment is not the same as receiving an approved order cancellation.
If you no longer want a product that has already shipped, please contact customer support before refusing delivery.
Refused shipments may require additional carrier handling or return processing.
Any refund or shipping-related charges will be determined according to the circumstances, our published policies, and applicable law.
18. Cancellation Requests Outside Business Hours
Our live chat channel is available 24/7, and email requests can be submitted at any time.
Telephone support operates during the following hours:
Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT).
Submitting a request outside telephone business hours does not automatically stop fulfillment.
We recommend using live chat or email promptly when a cancellation is time-sensitive.
19. How Will I Know My Order Was Canceled?
An approved cancellation will be confirmed through an available customer communication channel.
The confirmation may include:
* Order number
* Cancellation status
* Canceled products
* Applicable refund amount
* Relevant refund information
If you have submitted a cancellation request but have not received confirmation, do not assume the order has been canceled.
Contact customer support for an update.
20. What if My Cancellation Request Is Declined?
A cancellation request may be declined when the order has progressed beyond the stage where it can reasonably be stopped.
If cancellation is unavailable, our support team will explain the available options.
Depending on the circumstances, you may be able to request a return after delivery.
This policy does not limit any legal rights relating to non-delivery, defective goods, or other qualifying circumstances.
21. Customer Responsibilities
To help us review cancellation requests efficiently, customers should:

* Explain which items should be canceled.
* Verify the email address associated with the order.
* Review the cancellation confirmation.

At lumeero, we believe paying for your electronics should be straightforward, convenient, and transparent.

Whether you're purchasing computer components, gaming equipment, electronics accessories, or other technology products, our goal is to provide a clear checkout experience where you can review your payment options and order total before completing your purchase.
This Payment Policy explains how payments are processed, which payment options may be available, how billing and refunds work, and what to do if you experience a payment-related issue.
This policy applies to purchases made through https://lumeero.us, operated by Stone Canyon Leathers.
1. Accepted Payment Methods
We offer the payment methods displayed as available during checkout.
Depending on the payment services currently enabled, these may include:
* Credit Cards: Eligible Visa, Mastercard, American Express, or Discover cards, where supported.
* Debit Cards: Eligible debit cards authorized for online purchases.
* Digital Wallets: Supported digital payment options, where available.
* Buy Now, Pay Later: Eligible installment payment services, if offered during checkout.
The payment methods available for a particular order may depend on the transaction amount, payment provider, customer eligibility, and other applicable requirements.
Only payment methods displayed and functioning at checkout are considered currently accepted.
We do not guarantee the availability of any specific card network, digital wallet, or financing provider unless it is explicitly offered during checkout.
2. Credit & Debit Card Payments
If card payments are available during checkout, customers can use eligible credit or debit cards supported by our payment processing provider.
When making a card payment, you may be asked to provide:
* Cardholder name
* Card number
* Expiration date
* Card security code
* Billing address
* Additional verification information, where required
Payment authorization is subject to approval by the relevant card issuer and payment processor.
For your security, never send complete payment card details or card security codes through email, live chat, or our contact form.
3. Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL)
Flexible Payment Options Where Available
Some customers may prefer to divide an eligible purchase into installments.
If lumeero offers a Buy Now, Pay Later service during checkout, customers may be able to apply for installment financing through the relevant provider.
Availability and approval depend on the provider's requirements.
BNPL services may include:
* Installment payment schedules
* Eligibility checks
* Provider-specific spending limits
* Interest or financing charges, where applicable
* Late-payment fees, where permitted
* Additional terms and conditions
Not all financing arrangements are interest-free.
Customers should review the complete financing agreement before accepting an installment payment plan.
Important: lumeero does not determine financing eligibility or guarantee approval.
Learn More About Buy Now, Pay Later
4. Digital Wallet Payments
Digital wallet options may be available if supported by our checkout system and payment providers.
These services can allow customers to complete eligible purchases using a connected payment account or saved payment credentials.
Availability may depend on:
* Device compatibility
* Browser support
* Customer location
* Payment provider configuration
* Transaction eligibility
Please review the payment options displayed during checkout.
5. Secure Payment Processing
Your Payment Information Matters
We recognize the importance of protecting customer payment information.
Payments are processed through the payment services integrated with our website.
Depending on the payment method, customers may be redirected to a third-party payment page or complete payment through an embedded checkout interface.
Payment providers may use security measures such as:
* Encrypted payment transmission
* Payment tokenization
* Fraud detection
* Transaction monitoring
* Cardholder authentication
* Additional identity verification
The specific protections depend on the payment provider and its integration.
No online payment system can guarantee absolute security.
Customers should protect their account credentials and avoid sharing sensitive payment information through unsecured channels.
6. Payment Authorization
When an order is submitted, the selected payment provider may request authorization from the customer's bank or card issuer.
Payment authorization confirms whether the payment method can be used for the transaction.
Depending on the provider, an authorization may temporarily reserve funds before a payment is captured.
An authorization is not always the same as a completed charge.
If an order is canceled before payment capture, the authorization may be released rather than refunded.
The time required for an authorization hold to disappear depends on the financial institution.
7. When Will I Be Charged?
The timing of payment capture depends on the payment method and checkout configuration.
Payment may be collected when the order is placed or according to the payment provider's applicable transaction process.
Customers should review the final payment information before confirming their order.
For installment payments, the provider's agreement determines when installments are collected.
8. Currency
All Storefront Prices Are Displayed in USD
Prices on lumeero.us are displayed in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise stated.
If a customer uses a payment account denominated in another currency, their bank or payment provider may apply:
* Currency conversion
* Exchange rate adjustments
* Foreign transaction fees
* Other provider-specific charges
These charges are determined by the relevant financial institution and are not controlled by lumeero.
9. Pricing Transparency
We aim to provide clear pricing information before customers complete their purchases.
During checkout, customers should be able to review:
* Product prices
* Quantities
* Applicable discounts
* Shipping charges, if any
* Applicable taxes
* Final order total
The final amount payable will be displayed before payment confirmation.
If a pricing or calculation error is identified, we will handle the affected order in accordance with applicable law and our Terms of Service.
10. Sales Tax
Applicable sales taxes may be calculated during checkout based on the product, delivery destination, and relevant tax requirements.
Customers can review any applicable sales tax before confirming their order.
Tax treatment may vary depending on the transaction and jurisdiction.
11. Promotional Codes & Discounts
From time to time, lumeero may offer promotional discounts or coupon codes.
Promotions may be subject to:
* Expiration dates
* Product eligibility
* Minimum purchase requirements
* Maximum discount limits
* Usage restrictions
* Other disclosed conditions
If a valid promotional code is available, customers can enter it during checkout where supported.
Discounts cannot necessarily be applied retroactively to completed purchases.
12. Payment Confirmation
After successfully submitting an order, customers should receive an order confirmation through the contact information provided during checkout.
The confirmation may include:
* Order number
* Purchased items
* Order total
* Payment status
* Shipping information
* Relevant transaction details
If you do not receive an order confirmation, please check your spam or junk folder.
If you believe payment was collected but your order was not created, contact customer support before attempting another payment.
Email: info@lumeero.site
13. Declined Payments
A payment may be declined for several reasons.
Common causes include:
* Incorrect payment information
* Insufficient available funds
* Expired payment card
* Card issuer restrictions
* Failed security verification
* Transaction limits
* Payment provider restrictions
* Temporary processing errors
If your payment is declined, verify your information and contact your bank or payment provider where necessary.
You may also try another supported payment method.
lumeero cannot override a bank's or financing provider's authorization decision.
14. Payment Processing Errors
If you experience an error during checkout, avoid repeatedly submitting the same payment without checking whether the transaction was completed.
Recommended steps:
1. Check whether you received an order confirmation.
2. Review your payment account for pending or completed transactions.
3. Confirm that your payment information is correct.
4. Contact customer support if the issue remains unresolved.
When contacting us, provide:
* Your name
* Email address used during checkout
* Approximate transaction date and time
* Payment method or provider
* Description of the error
* Order number, if available
Never share complete card numbers, card security codes, passwords, or banking credentials.
15. Duplicate Payments
If you believe you were charged more than once for the same order, contact us promptly.
Our support team can review available order and payment records.
Depending on the circumstances, a duplicate transaction may be:
* A temporary authorization hold
* An unsuccessful transaction awaiting release
* A completed duplicate payment requiring correction
If an erroneous duplicate charge is confirmed, we will coordinate an appropriate correction or refund.
16. Order Verification & Fraud Prevention
To protect customers and our business, certain orders may require additional verification.
Verification may involve reviewing:
* Billing information
* Shipping information
* Payment authorization status
* Transaction risk indicators
* Other relevant order details
We may temporarily delay or cancel an order if payment cannot be verified or the transaction presents a legitimate security concern.
Where appropriate, we will contact the customer to explain the next steps.
We will not request complete card security codes or account passwords through email or live chat.
17. Payment for Canceled Orders
If an order is canceled and a payment has already been collected, any applicable refund will be initiated according to our Order Cancellation Policy.
If the transaction has not yet been captured, the payment authorization may instead be released.
The time required for funds to become available depends on the customer's bank or payment provider.
Order Cancellation Policy
18. Refunds to the Original Payment Method
Approved refunds are generally issued to the original payment method where supported.
Refund processing depends on:
* Return or cancellation eligibility
* Payment transaction status
* Payment provider procedures
* Bank or card issuer processing times
For approved product returns, the refund timeline is explained in our Returns & Refunds Policy.
Returns & Refunds Policy
19. Refunds for Installment Payments
If you purchased a product using an installment payment provider, approved refunds are generally processed through that provider.
The provider may:
* Adjust outstanding installments
* Reduce the remaining balance
* Cancel future payments
* Refund previously collected amounts
The exact process depends on the provider's terms and the status of the financing agreement.
Continue following your payment provider's instructions until it confirms any changes to your repayment schedule.
20. Payment Disputes & Chargebacks
If you have a concern about a payment or purchase, we encourage you to contact customer support so we can review the issue.
You may also have the right to dispute a transaction with your bank, card issuer, or payment provider.
If a dispute is opened, the payment provider may investigate the transaction according to its procedures.
Nothing in this policy limits your lawful payment dispute rights or applicable consumer protections.
21. Unauthorized Transactions
If you believe your payment method has been used without authorization, contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
You may also notify our support team so we can review any relevant order records.
For security reasons, we may request appropriate verification before discussing transaction-specific information.
22. Customer Payment Responsibilities
Customers are responsible for:
* Providing accurate billing information
* Using payment methods they are authorized to use
* Reviewing the final order total
* Following applicable payment provider terms
* Protecting their payment credentials
* Contacting their financial institution about account-specific issues
These responsibilities do not limit applicable consumer rights.
23. Payment Provider Terms
Third-party payment providers operate under their own terms and privacy policies.
When selecting a payment method, customers may be subject to the provider's:
* Eligibility requirements
* Transaction limits
* Verification procedures
* Financing agreements
* Refund procedures
* Privacy practices
* Dispute processes
We encourage customers to review the applicable terms before completing payment.
24. Our Payment Commitment
At lumeero, we aim to provide a transparent and convenient payment experience.
Our commitments include:
* Displaying available payment methods during checkout
* Providing clear pricing information
* Showing applicable charges before order confirmation
* Using supported payment processing integrations
* Assisting with merchant-side payment inquiries
* Processing approved refunds through the appropriate channels
* Respecting applicable payment and consumer protection requirements
We believe customers should understand how their payments are handled before completing a purchase.
25. Contact Us for Payment Assistance
If you have questions about payment methods, checkout errors, transaction status, or refunds, contact our customer support team.

Legal Business Name: Stone Canyon Leathers
Website: https://lumeero.us
Email: info@lumeero.site

Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT)
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Contact Us
Order Help Center
26. Payment Policy Updates
We may update this Payment Policy to reflect changes in our accepted payment methods, payment processing arrangements, operational procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on this page with the corresponding updated date.
Changes will not retroactively eliminate rights applicable to transactions already completed.

More Payment Flexibility for Your Technology Purchases
At lumeero, we believe customers should have clear information and convenient payment choices when shopping for electronics.

Whether you're upgrading your computer, purchasing gaming equipment, exploring 3D printers, or shopping for everyday technology, eligible Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services may allow you to spread the cost of a purchase over multiple payments.
When installment financing is available at checkout, you can review the payment options, repayment schedule, and applicable terms before deciding whether to proceed.
Shop the Technology You Need. Choose a Payment Option That Works for You.
1. What Is Buy Now, Pay Later?
Buy Now, Pay Later is a payment arrangement offered by third-party financing providers that allows eligible customers to divide the cost of a purchase into scheduled payments.
Instead of paying the entire purchase price upfront, approved customers may be able to pay over time according to the provider's financing agreement.
Depending on the provider and the selected plan, BNPL arrangements may include:
* Multiple scheduled installments
* Short-term payment plans
* Longer-term financing options
* Automatic payment collection
* Eligibility or credit checks
* Interest or financing charges
* Late-payment fees, where permitted
Not all BNPL plans are interest-free.
The financing provider determines the available plans, repayment terms, eligibility requirements, and applicable charges.
2. How Buy Now, Pay Later Works
If a BNPL service is available during checkout, the process generally follows these steps.
Step 1 - Shop Your Favorite Electronics
Browse the lumeero product catalog and select the products you want to purchase.
Review the product specifications, condition, price, and availability before adding items to your cart.
Shop All Electronics
Step 2 - Proceed to Checkout
Once you're ready to purchase, proceed to checkout and enter your required billing and shipping information.
Review your order summary, including applicable taxes and shipping charges.
Step 3 - Select Buy Now, Pay Later
If an eligible BNPL service is available for your order, it will appear among the payment methods during checkout.
Select the available installment payment option to review the provider's offer.
Step 4 - Review Your Financing Terms
The financing provider may ask you to complete an eligibility assessment or provide additional information.
Before accepting a financing agreement, review:
* Total purchase amount
* Amount due at checkout
* Number of installments
* Payment due dates
* Interest rate, if applicable
* Financing charges, if applicable
* Late-payment terms
* Total amount payable
Step 5 - Complete Your Purchase
If your application is approved and you accept the financing terms, the provider will process the payment according to its procedures.
Your order will then be subject to our normal order acceptance and fulfillment process.
Step 6 - Manage Your Installments
After purchase, the financing provider manages your repayment schedule.
You may be able to review upcoming payments and outstanding balances through the provider's website or application.
Customers are responsible for following the agreed payment schedule.
3. Available Buy Now, Pay Later Providers
lumeero may offer installment payment services through supported third-party providers.
The exact financing providers available to you will be displayed during checkout.
Availability may depend on:
* The payment services currently enabled
* Purchase amount
* Product eligibility
* Customer eligibility
* Billing information
* Financing provider requirements
* Applicable laws and restrictions
A BNPL provider is only considered available when its payment option is displayed and functioning at checkout.
We do not guarantee that Affirm, Afterpay, Klarna, PayPal Pay Later, or any other specific provider is available unless it is expressly offered during your transaction.
4. Benefits of Installment Payment Options
When used responsibly, installment payment services may offer customers additional flexibility.
Flexible Payment Scheduling
Eligible customers may be able to divide the purchase amount into scheduled installments rather than paying the entire amount at once.
Clear Repayment Information
Financing providers generally present the applicable repayment schedule and charges before the customer accepts an agreement.
Convenient Checkout
When integrated into checkout, installment payment options allow eligible customers to apply for financing during the purchase process.
Purchase Planning
Scheduled payments may help customers plan their spending, provided they understand the total repayment obligation and can comfortably meet the due dates.

Important: Installment financing does not reduce the purchase price unless a specific promotional discount is separately offered. Borrowing can increase the total cost of a purchase when interest or fees apply.
5. Eligibility Requirements
Approval for Buy Now, Pay Later financing is determined by the relevant provider.
Eligibility requirements may include:
* Minimum age requirements
* Eligible US residency
* Valid contact information
* Supported payment method
* Identity verification
* Credit or affordability assessments
* Purchase amount restrictions
* Provider-specific account requirements
Meeting general eligibility requirements does not guarantee approval.
lumeero does not make financing approval decisions and cannot override a provider's decision.
6. Are Buy Now, Pay Later Payments Interest-Free?
Some financing providers offer interest-free payment plans for eligible transactions.
However, not every BNPL arrangement is interest-free.
Depending on the provider and financing plan, customers may be charged:
* Interest
* Financing fees
* Late-payment fees
* Other charges disclosed in the financing agreement
The provider's terms determine the total repayment amount.
Customers should carefully review the financing disclosure before accepting a payment plan.
7. Does Buy Now, Pay Later Require a Credit Check?
Some BNPL providers may conduct eligibility or credit checks.
Depending on the provider and financing product, these checks may be soft inquiries or hard credit inquiries.
Certain providers may also report payment activity to credit reporting agencies.
The impact on your credit history depends on the provider's policies and the specific financing arrangement.
Review the provider's disclosures before applying.
8. Payment Schedules and Installments
The number and frequency of payments depend on the financing provider.
A provider may offer weekly, biweekly, monthly, or other repayment arrangements.
The available schedule will be disclosed before the financing agreement is accepted.

9. What Happens if My BNPL Application Is Declined?
Financing providers make independent eligibility decisions.
An application may be declined because of:
* Provider eligibility requirements
* Identity verification issues
* Purchase amount restrictions
* Credit or affordability considerations
* Payment method restrictions
* Other provider-specific factors
If your application is declined, you may be able to select another payment method displayed at checkout.
For questions about a financing decision, contact the relevant provider.
lumeero generally cannot access or change the provider's internal approval criteria.
10. Can I Use BNPL for Every Product?
Not necessarily.
BNPL availability may depend on the product category, purchase amount, provider restrictions, and other eligibility requirements.
Some items or transactions may not qualify.
If an installment option is unavailable during checkout, it cannot be assumed to be supported for that order.
11. Can I Pay Off My Installments Early?
Early repayment options depend on the provider's terms.
Some providers allow customers to pay outstanding balances before their scheduled due dates.
Others may apply specific conditions or procedures.
Contact the financing provider or review your agreement for details about early repayment.
12. What Happens if I Miss a Payment?
Missing an installment payment may have consequences.
Depending on the provider and financing agreement, these may include:
* Late-payment fees
* Account restrictions
* Collection activity
* Credit reporting consequences
* Additional charges where permitted by law
Customers should review the provider's repayment terms carefully.
If you anticipate difficulty making a payment, contact your financing provider as soon as possible to discuss available options.
13. Returns for Buy Now, Pay Later Purchases
Products purchased using BNPL are generally subject to the same applicable return eligibility rules as other purchases from lumeero.
If you wish to return a product, please contact our customer support team and follow the return authorization process.
Return eligibility depends on our published Returns & Refunds Policy and applicable law.
Read Our Returns & Refunds Policy
14. How BNPL Refunds Work
If a return or cancellation is approved, the applicable refund will generally be processed through the original financing provider.
Depending on the provider and transaction status, the provider may:
* Reduce the outstanding balance
* Adjust future installments
* Cancel remaining payments
* Refund installments already collected
* Update the financing account
The provider determines how the refund is applied to the financing agreement.
Continue making required payments until your financing provider confirms an adjustment to your repayment schedule.
Submitting a return request does not automatically suspend your financing obligations.
15. Partial Returns and Partial Refunds
If an order contains multiple products and only some items are returned, an approved partial refund may be processed through the BNPL provider.
The provider may adjust the remaining balance or future installments according to its terms.
The revised payment schedule, if applicable, should be confirmed directly with the provider.
16. Canceling a BNPL Order
If you need to cancel an order paid through BNPL, contact lumeero as soon as possible.
Cancellation eligibility depends on the order's fulfillment status.
If cancellation is approved, we will process the applicable payment reversal or refund through the financing provider.
The provider will determine how the cancellation affects the financing agreement.
Order Cancellation Policy
17. BNPL Payment Disputes
If you have a concern about a product, order, return, or refund, contact lumeero customer support.
For financing account questions, installment charges, payment schedules, or provider-specific disputes, contact your BNPL provider.
Customers may also have dispute rights under applicable laws and financing agreements.
Nothing in this policy limits those rights.
18. Privacy and Personal Information
Applying for BNPL financing may require customers to provide information directly to a third-party financing provider.
The provider may collect and process information for purposes such as:
* Identity verification
* Financing eligibility
* Credit assessment
* Fraud prevention
* Payment processing
* Account administration
The provider's privacy policy governs its independent processing activities.
For information about how lumeero handles customer data, please review our Privacy Policy.
Privacy Policy
19. Responsible Use of Installment Financing
We encourage customers to make informed payment decisions.
Before selecting a BNPL plan, consider:
* Whether the purchase fits your budget
* The total amount you will repay
* The timing of each installment
* Any applicable interest or fees
* Existing financial commitments
* The consequences of missed payments
Only accept financing terms that you understand and can reasonably manage.
BNPL is a financial obligation, not a discount or free payment service.
20. Frequently Asked Questions
Is Buy Now, Pay Later available at lumeero?
BNPL may be available when a supported financing provider is enabled during checkout. Only the payment methods displayed at checkout are currently available.
Does lumeero approve financing applications?
No. Financing applications are reviewed and approved or declined by the relevant provider.
Can I use BNPL without a credit check?
That depends on the provider and the financing plan. Some services may conduct credit or eligibility checks.
Are all installment plans interest-free?
No. Interest and fees depend on the provider and financing agreement.
Can I return a product purchased with BNPL?
Eligible products can be returned according to our Returns & Refunds Policy and applicable law.
What happens to my installments after a refund?
The financing provider will determine how the refund affects your outstanding balance and scheduled payments.
Can I change my installment due dates?
Payment schedule changes are controlled by the financing provider. Contact the provider for assistance.
What if I am charged after canceling an order?
Contact the financing provider to review the payment schedule and contact lumeero if you need assistance confirming the merchant-side cancellation or refund status.
Can I use two BNPL providers for one order?
Combining multiple financing providers is not supported unless the checkout expressly offers that functionality.
Who should I contact about a BNPL payment problem?
Contact lumeero for merchant-side order, cancellation, or refund questions. Contact your financing provider for repayment schedules, account balances, and financing charges.
21. Our Commitment to Payment Transparency
At lumeero, we believe customers should understand their payment options before completing a purchase.
